Existing plant may naturally occlude a lower-leg/shoe portion; do not invent or move furniture to expose it.
Preserve the approved near-camera human scale, with the whole original-style person within the frame. Bench figures may have hair top around y110–140 and shoe depth following the real seat; a desk figure follows the actual deeper chair perspective, never a mechanically pasted bench scale. Do not enlarge the head, lean toward the lens, stretch shins or resize furniture to force coordinates. Both eyes/bangs, hands/wrists and visible limb connections remain coherent; no extra limb, fused fingers, furniture penetration or one crossed knee pretending both parallel feet are flat. Keep every actually visible shoe edge truthful; do not invent hidden anatomy behind the existing foreground plant. Gentle local contact shadows. Apricot almond-gold clear-day light on hair, hands and paper, with clear natural face shadow planes and local clothing colors. Refined 2D anime linework and soft anime shading integrated with the exact detailed literary room.
